digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler binding store baseline serialization
propositions: Baseline description, status, and priority fields are stored as normalized scalars (e.g., 'In Progress', 'High', plain text) instead of vendor dicts to reduce file size by approximately 66%.
Assignee field is deliberately preserved in its raw vendor dict form with all identity variants to maintain inbound suppression behavior and concurrent edit safety.
The normalized baseline produces identical live comparison verdicts through compute_update_fields when compared against the original vendor-dict form through real Jira mappers.
The pre-A3 reader accepts both scalar and vendor-dict forms without requiring migration, enabling safe rollback via single Gerrit revert without lossy denormalization.
Corpus validation across all 1,774 baseline entries confirms zero mutation deltas in both forward and rollback directions, zero assignee shape changes, and at least 50% serialized size reduction.
